narrative.title: The Diagnostics Channel Swapper
narrative.scenario: Legacy diagnostics devices broadcast commands operator-last, while the modern control bus expects operator-first messages. The gateway scans each incoming command left-to-right, holding partially translated messages on a buffer; on every operator it re-emits the operator first, followed by the two buffered messages in swapped order.
narrative.inputFormat: A string expression in valid postfix form with single alphanumeric operands.
narrative.outputFormat: Return the equivalent prefix (Polish) expression as a string.
constraints: Operands are single letters or digits
The expression is guaranteed to be a valid postfix expression

testCases.explanation: Each operator is hoisted to the front of the two fragments it merges, inverting the postfix layout.
The + merges a and b first; the * then fronts the whole group with c.
